1.text: Tha burden of Nineveh. tha book of tha vision of Nahum tha Elkoshite.
God is jealous, N tha LORD revengeth; tha LORD revengeth, N is furious; tha LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, N he reserveth wrath 4 his opps. is a jealous God, N a revenger, etc
Tha LORD is slow 2 anger, N great in power, N will not at all acquit tha wicked: tha LORD has his way in tha whirlwind N in tha storm, N tha clouds r tha dust of his feet.
He rebuketh tha sea, N makes it dry, N drieth up all tha rivers: Bashan languishes, N Carmel, N tha flower of Lebanon languishes.
Tha mountains quake at him, N tha hills melt, N tha earth is burned at his presence, yeah, tha world, N all dat live in it.
Who can stand before his indignation? N who can abide in tha fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, N tha rocks r thrown down by him.
Tha LORD is good, a strong hold in tha day of trouble; N he knows ’em dat trust in him.
But wit an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of tha place of it, N darkness shall pursue his opps.
What do y’all imagine against tha LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up tha second time.
4 while dey be folden together as thorns, N while dey r drunken as drunkards, dey shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
There is one come out of u, dat imagineth evil against tha LORD, a wicked counsellor.
Like dis says tha LORD; Though dey be quiet, N likewise many, yet like dis shall dey be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted u, I will afflict u no more.
4 now will I break his yoke from off u, N will burst ur bonds in sunder.
N tha LORD has given a commandment concerning u, dat no more of ur name be sown: out of tha house of ur gods will I cut off tha graven image N tha molten image: I will make ur grave; 4 u r vile.

Look upon tha mountains tha feet of him dat brings good tidings, dat publisheth peace! O Judah, keep ur solemn feasts, perform ur vows: 4 tha wicked shall no more pass through u; he is utterly cut off.

2.text: He dat dasheth in pieces is come up before ur face: keep tha munition, watch tha way, make ur loins strong, fortify ur power mightily.
4 tha LORD has turned away tha excellency of Jacob, as tha excellency of Israel: 4 tha emptiers have emptied ’em out, N marred their vine branches.
Tha shield of his mighty men is made red, tha valiant men r in scarlet: tha chariots shall be wit flaming torches in tha day of his preparation, N tha fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
Tha chariots shall rage in tha streets, dey shall justle one against another in tha broad ways: dey shall seem like torches, dey shall run like tha lightnings.
He shall recount his worthies: dey shall stumble in their walk; dey shall make haste 2 tha wall of it, N tha defence shall be prepared.
Tha gates of tha rivers shall be opened, N tha palace shall be dissolved.
N Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, N her maids shall lead her as wit tha voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet dey shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall dey cry; but none shall look back.
Take y’all tha spoil of silver, take tha spoil of gold: 4 there is none end of tha store N glory out of all tha pleasant furniture.
She is empty, N void, N waste: N tha heart melts, N tha knees strike together, N much pain is in all loins, N tha faces of ’em all gather blackness.
Where is tha livin of tha lions, N tha feedingplace of tha young lions, where tha lion, even tha old lion, walked, N tha lion’s whelp, N none made ’em afraid?
Tha lion did tear in pieces enough 4 his whelps, N strangled 4 his lionesses, N filled his holes wit prey, N his dens wit ravin.

Look, I am against u, says tha LORD of hosts, N I will burn her chariots in tha smoke, N tha sword shall devour ur young lions: N I will cut off ur prey from tha earth, N tha voice of ur messengers shall no more be heard.

3.text: Woe 2 tha bloody city! it is all full of lies N robbery; tha prey departs not;
Tha noise of a whip, N tha noise of tha rattling of tha wheels, N of tha pransing horses, N of tha jumping chariots.
Tha horseman lifts up both tha bright sword N tha glittering spear: N there is a crowd of killed, N a great number of carcases; N there is none end of their corpses; dey stumble upon their corpses:
Because of tha crowd of tha whoredoms of tha wellfavoured harlot, tha mistress of witchcrafts, dat sells nations through her whoredoms, N families through her witchcrafts.
Look, I am against u, says tha LORD of hosts; N I will discover ur skirts upon ur face, N I will show tha nations ur nakedness, N tha kingdoms ur shame.
N I will cast abominable filth upon u, N make u vile, N will set u as a gazingstock.
N it will happen, dat all dey dat look upon u shall flee from u, N say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? from where shall I seek comforters 4 u?
R u better than populous No, dat was situate among tha rivers, dat had tha waterz round about it, whose rampart was tha sea, N her wall was from tha sea?
Ethiopia N Egypt were her strength, N it was infinite; Put N Lubim were ur helpers.

Yet was she carried away, she went in2 captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at tha top of all tha streets: N dey cast lots 4 her honourable men, N all her great men were bound in chains.
u also will be drunken: u will be hid, u also will seek strength because of tha opp.
All ur strong holds shall be like fig trees wit tha firstripe figs: if dey be shaken, dey shall even fall in2 tha mouth of tha eater.
Look, ur people in tha midst of u r women: tha gates of ur land shall be set wide open 2 thine opps: tha fire shall devour ur bars.
Draw u waterz 4 tha siege, fortify ur strong holds: go in2 clay, N tread tha morter, make strong tha brickkiln.
There shall tha fire devour u; tha sword shall cut u off, it shall eat u up like tha cankerworm: make urself many as tha cankerworm, make urself many as tha locusts.
u have multiplied ur merchants above tha stars of heaven: tha cankerworm spoileth, N flieth away.
Ur crowned r as tha locusts, N ur captains as tha great grasshoppers, which camp in tha hedges in tha cold day, but when tha sun arises dey flee away, N their place is not known where dey r.
Ur shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: ur nobles shall live in tha dust: ur people is scattered upon tha mountains, N no man gathers ’em.
There is no healin of ur bruise; ur wound is grievous: all dat hear tha bruit of u shall clap tha hands over u: 4 upon whom has not ur wickedness passed continually?
